muscle_strength.name: Muscle strength
muscle_strength.why_it_matters: Tracks muscle force against the personal pre-flight baseline, with priority given to the legs and trunk.
muscle_strength.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; [1] NASA-STD-3001, Vol. 1, Rev. C, section 4.6.2 (V1 4024).

muscle_area.name: Muscle cross-sectional area
muscle_area.why_it_matters: Tracks changes in muscle size against the personal pre-flight baseline. No validated clinical danger interval is provided.
muscle_area.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; proposed prototype review bands [P].

muscle_power.name: Muscle power
muscle_power.why_it_matters: Tracks muscle power during a comparable instrumented task. No validated danger threshold is provided.
muscle_power.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; proposed prototype review bands [P].

muscle_endurance.name: Muscle endurance
muscle_endurance.why_it_matters: Tracks repetitions at a fixed load in a comparable task where fewer repetitions mean poorer endurance. No validated danger threshold is provided.
muscle_endurance.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1; proposed prototype review bands [P].

muscle_tone.name: Muscle tone
muscle_tone.why_it_matters: Complements muscle monitoring through mechanical properties; changes alone do not diagnose atrophy.

muscle_stiffness.name: Muscle stiffness
muscle_stiffness.why_it_matters: Complements muscle monitoring, assessed separately from tone; changes alone do not diagnose atrophy.

peripapillary_trt_left.name: Peripapillary total retinal thickness (left eye)
peripapillary_trt_left.why_it_matters: Tracks OCT retinal thickening against the same eye's pre-flight baseline; eyes must not be averaged.
peripapillary_trt_left.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; [2] NASA, SANS: 2023 Clinical Update; [3] Gew et al., SANS consensus (2026), Table 2.

optic_disc_edema_grade_left.name: Optic disc edema (Frisen grade) (left eye)
optic_disc_edema_grade_left.why_it_matters: Records expert assessment of optic disc edema as an ordinal grade, not a z-score; each eye is assessed separately.
optic_disc_edema_grade_left.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; [2] NASA, SANS: 2023 Clinical Update.

refraction_left.name: Refraction (left eye)
refraction_left.why_it_matters: Tracks a signed positive shift toward hyperopia against the same eye's baseline; the guide selects the 2026 profile.
refraction_left.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; [3] Gew et al., SANS consensus (2026), Table 2.

visual_acuity_left.name: Corrected monocular visual acuity (left eye)
visual_acuity_left.why_it_matters: Tracks corrected vision in each eye; higher logMAR means poorer vision. Statistical review bands are prototype proposals, not validated SANS limits.
visual_acuity_left.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Proposed prototype review bands [P].

peripapillary_trt_right.name: Peripapillary total retinal thickness (right eye)
peripapillary_trt_right.why_it_matters: Tracks OCT retinal thickening against the same eye's pre-flight baseline; eyes must not be averaged.
peripapillary_trt_right.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; [2] NASA, SANS: 2023 Clinical Update; [3] Gew et al., SANS consensus (2026), Table 2.

optic_disc_edema_grade_right.name: Optic disc edema (Frisen grade) (right eye)
optic_disc_edema_grade_right.why_it_matters: Records expert assessment of optic disc edema as an ordinal grade, not a z-score; each eye is assessed separately.
optic_disc_edema_grade_right.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; [2] NASA, SANS: 2023 Clinical Update.

refraction_right.name: Refraction (right eye)
refraction_right.why_it_matters: Tracks a signed positive shift toward hyperopia against the same eye's baseline; the guide selects the 2026 profile.
refraction_right.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; [3] Gew et al., SANS consensus (2026), Table 2.

visual_acuity_right.name: Corrected monocular visual acuity (right eye)
visual_acuity_right.why_it_matters: Tracks corrected vision in each eye; higher logMAR means poorer vision. Statistical review bands are prototype proposals, not validated SANS limits.
visual_acuity_right.source: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Proposed prototype review bands [P].

_example_indicator.name: Example indicator (test fixture, not health data)
_example_indicator.why_it_matters: Used only to test the engine.

_example_indicator_2.name: Second example indicator (test fixture, not health data)
_example_indicator_2.why_it_matters: Used only to test symptom-based problems.
